env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
go run ./feed
stdout 'feed-ok'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/feed

go 1.27

-- w/feed/main.go --
package main

import (
	stdjson "encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	rtjson "logos/rt/json"
)

// Lone-surrogate documents must decode exactly like encoding/json;
// truncated or malformed escapes must fail on both sides.
var valid = []string{
	`"a\uDC00b"`,
	`"a\uD800b"`,
	`"a\uD800\u0041b"`,
	`"a\uD800\uD800\uDC00b"`,
	`"\uDC00"`,
	`"\uD800"`,
	`"\uD83D\uDE00"`,
	`"\\\uD800\\"`,
}

var invalid = []string{
	`"a\uD800\u004"`,
	`"a\uD800\u"`,
	`"a\uD800\xb"`,
	`"a\uD8"`,
}

func pump(s *rtjson.FeedScanner, out *[]byte, sawEnd *bool) error {
	for {
		t, ok := s.Next()
		if !ok {
			return s.Err()
		}
		switch t.Kind {
		case rtjson.TokenPartialString, rtjson.TokenString:
			*out = append(*out, t.Bytes...)
		case rtjson.TokenEndOfDocument:
			*sawEnd = true
			return nil
		}
	}
}

func scanDoc(doc string, cut int) (string, error) {
	data := []byte(doc)
	chunks := [][]byte{data}
	if cut >= 0 {
		chunks = [][]byte{data[:cut], data[cut:]}
	}
	var s rtjson.FeedScanner
	var out []byte
	sawEnd := false
	for _, c := range chunks {
		if len(c) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		s.Feed(c)
		if err := pump(&s, &out, &sawEnd); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		if sawEnd {
			break
		}
	}
	s.End()
	if err := pump(&s, &out, &sawEnd); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if !sawEnd {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("missing end of document")
	}
	return string(out), nil
}

func main() {
	failed := false
	for _, doc := range valid {
		var std string
		if err := stdjson.Unmarshal([]byte(doc), &std); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("oracle rejects valid %q: %v\n", doc, err)
			failed = true
			continue
		}
		for cut := -1; cut <= len(doc); cut++ {
			got, err := scanDoc(doc, cut)
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Printf("feed rejects %q at cut %d: %v\n", doc, cut, err)
				failed = true
				continue
			}
			if got != std {
				fmt.Printf("feed decoded %q at cut %d as %q, want %q\n", doc, cut, got, std)
				failed = true
			}
		}
	}
	for _, doc := range invalid {
		var std string
		stdErr := stdjson.Unmarshal([]byte(doc), &std)
		_, feedErr := scanDoc(doc, -1)
		if stdErr == nil || feedErr == nil {
			fmt.Printf("invalid accepted %q: std=%v feed=%v\n", doc, stdErr, feedErr)
			failed = true
		}
	}
	if failed {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("feed-ok")
}
